title: Eurostat sdg_11_52: premature deaths due to PM2.5 exposure, Italy (annual, JSON-stat)
summary: Eurostat JSON-stat extract (filtered to geo=IT) of premature deaths attributed to exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5), annual, in two units (number and rate). The full extract has 36 cells (18 years x 2 units), with no missing cells and no status flags. It is a national-level statistic for Italy only, with no regional, district, hourly or clinic-level detail. The Eurostat label reports the data as last updated 2025-12-09.

licence.evidence: The Eurostat copyright and re-use page was reached (probe_url, https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/main/help/copyright-notice, status 200, titled 'Copyright notice and free re-use of data'), but the extracted text was page script and did not show the licence wording. No licence statement was found in the JSON-stat response or the catalog. The licence is therefore not established.

documentation_excerpts: Label: 'Premature deaths due to exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5)', source 'ESTAT', updated '2025-12-09T11:00:00+0100' (inspect_dataset_link summary).
Dimensions: freq A: Annual; airpol PM2_5: Particulates < 2.5µm; effect PMD: Premature death; unit NR: Number, RT: Rate; geo IT: Italy; time 2005 to 2023 (18 values).
quality_notes: Coverage gap against the use case: the data ends in 2023. It does not cover the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 at all, and it starts in 2005, after the prototype start of 2004-03-10 (so 2004 is missing).
Time dimension has 18 values (2005, 2007 to 2023). 2006 is absent from the time list, although the expected-cells count (36 = 18 x 2 units) matches. Treat 2006 as missing, not zero.

Grain is annual and national only. It cannot support any hourly need (N1, N2, N3), the daily district clinic counts (N4), or patient-level records (N5). It fits only N6, the national yearly PM2.5 context, and only for years 2005-2023.
Eurostat's 'updated' date (2025-12-09) is the only freshness signal. No refresh cadence is stated in the materials reviewed.
The licence is not established (see licence). Use for prototyping or context is within the open-data policy, but production use needs Legal sign-off (policy.open_data_links).
